annotation.authors_or_issuer: Robotics and Autonomous Systems Special Interest Group (RAS-SIG), Technology Strategy Board (Innovate UK)
annotation.summary_en: July 2014 UK national strategy for robotics and autonomous systems, produced by the RAS-SIG under the Technology Strategy Board. It proposes five strands (coordination, assets, grand challenges, clusters, skills) to build an innovation pipeline, with real-world test sites, flexible regulation and standards dialogue to win market advantage.
annotation.title_clean: RAS 2020: A national strategy to capture value in a cross-sector UK RAS innovation pipeline through co-ordinated development of assets, challenges, clusters and skills
annotation.title_en: RAS 2020: A national strategy to capture value in a cross-sector UK RAS innovation pipeline through co-ordinated development of assets, challenges, clusters and skills
annotation.venue: Knowledge Transfer Network / Technology Strategy Board
key_provisions_or_claims: Invest in five strands: coordination, assets, grand challenges, clusters and skills
Establish a RAS Leadership Council for independent advisory oversight
Use real-world sites (roads, hospitals, nuclear sites, airfields) as RAS test assets with flexible, proactive regulation
Continue dialogue with BSI and CAA on standards and regulation
Extend public engagement to improve acceptance and address concerns such as dehumanisation of care
